status: proposed pre-outcome amendment; not adopted; requires maintainer decision
motivating_evidence: docs/tc-r1/offline-gate-result.md; identifies properties to examine, not parameter values
independence: each change is justified by a stated property or published bound; constants are the registered value or bound-derived; validation uses fresh seeds and unchanged criteria

mc_ucb_scale_equivariance.S: sqrt(median over regions of the registered RGB-mean within-pixel variance scalar V), from allocation observations at completion of common 16-spp initialization; frozen for the unit
mc_ucb_scale_equivariance.S_zero: fall back to least samples_per_pixel with geometry ties
mc_ucb_scale_equivariance.property: scaling all observations by c>0 scales every index by c and leaves decisions unchanged

defensive_floor.rule: after initialization, if any region has samples_per_pixel < alpha * mean over regions of samples_per_pixel, request 4 spp for the least-covered such region (geometry ties); otherwise use the method's index
defensive_floor.bound: each region's variance <= (1/alpha) x its uniform-allocation variance at equal total, up to one 4-spp batch; alpha from the bound, not fitted

symmetry.A_recommended: apply the identical defensive floor to the controller and both ablations as shared coverage; amends controller-contract.json before outcomes
symmetry.B: conventional methods only; controller contract unchanged

validation.on_pass: amendment effective for the execution freeze
validation.on_fail: stop; record no competent strong conventional baseline under this design; maintainer decision; no further parameter round against the same criteria

synthetic_conventional_efficiency_observ: yes: offline gate v1, seeds 0-2; the reason validation uses fresh seeds
